description: Filters shown in screener_hero_filter.png that are NOT implemented in TraderTavern's screener, grouped by the reference image's categories, with the reason each is unsupported given our current data.
mappingNotes: "52-Week (%)" in the reference image is mapped to our existing `changePercent1y` field (trailing 1-year change is the standard proxy for a 52-week change) rather than treated as missing.
"Vol / Avg" in the reference image is mapped to our existing `volumeRatio20d` field (latest volume relative to its 20-day average).

unsupported.reason: We don't track instrument/security type (equity vs. ETF vs. ADR, etc.); every synced ticker is treated the same, so there's no field to filter on.
No price-to-cashflow ratio is fetched or stored; only P/E, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA, EV/Sales, and PEG are available.
Return on invested capital requires an invested-capital figure (debt + equity - cash, or similar) we don't compute or store.
We store revenue growth but not a comparable EPS growth figure.
Composite 9-point fundamental health score; not computed or stored, and would require multiple historical financial statement inputs we don't currently persist.
Proprietary/qualitative competitive-advantage rating; no equivalent data source.
Requires quarterly earnings-surprise history (consecutive beats); we don't store any earnings history.
Requires actual vs. estimated EPS for the latest quarter; not fetched or stored.
We don't store the next scheduled earnings-report date.
Only a single (total) debt-to-equity figure is stored; long-term vs. short-term debt isn't broken out.
We store the current dividend yield and its 5-year average, but not year-over-year dividend growth history.
Requires the day's open price relative to the prior close; we only store change percentages over various windows, not intraday open/close deltas.

No raw daily trading volume is stored on the screener snapshot (only a 20-day volume ratio and a 10-day average volume); per-day volume only exists inside a separate candle collection that isn't joined into the screener listing.
Would require raw daily volume × price; raw volume isn't available on the screener snapshot (see "Volume" above).
Requires detecting that today's price just crossed the 52-week high, which needs day-over-day price history; we only store the current 52-week high/low levels, not a history to compare against.
Same limitation as "New 52W High" — no day-over-day price history to detect a fresh low.
We don't track a rolling 20-day high/low, only Bollinger Bands (20-period) and the 52-week high/low.
Same limitation as "Near 20D High".
We don't track a rolling 50-day high/low (only SMA 50, which is an average, not a high/low).
Same limitation as "Near 50D High".
No insider transaction data (buys/sells) is fetched or stored, only aggregate insider ownership percentage.
Same limitation as "Insider Net Buying" — no insider transaction data.
Same limitation as "Insider Net Buying" — no insider transaction data.
No short-interest data is fetched or stored.
No short-interest data is fetched or stored.
No short-interest data is fetched or stored.

Not a filter but a toggle changing null-handling; our min/max filters currently always exclude tickers with a null value for the filtered field. No UI toggle was added to bypass that — left out of scope for this pass.
